param_input_item.param_description: a filename, folder name, wildcard pattern, string array, or cell array of character vectors.

param_output_item.param_description: a structure containing the current filename and file index.

description.p: Properties are Files, ReadSize, SelectedVariableNames, OutputType, RowTimes, RowFilter, VariableNamingRule, and dependent property VariableNames.

read returns the next file as a table and advances the datastore. readall concatenates all remaining files after resetting the datastore. preview reads the first rows of the first file. hasdata indicates whether more files can be read. reset moves the datastore back to the first file.
